title_text: Glueing and orthogonality for models of linear logic

Inline.Text: We present the general theory of the method of glueing and associated technique of orthogonality for constructing categorical models of all the structure of linear logic: in particular we treat the exponentials in detail. We indicate simple applications of the methods and show that they cover familiar examples.
